ns2:course.label: Computer Methods
ns2:course.description: (CEE 391) Review of programming concepts; formulation and programming of numerical, data processing, and logical problems with applications from various branches of civil engineering; organization of programs and data; and development and use of problem-oriented programming languages in civil engineering. Same as CSE 491. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CS 101; senior or graduate standing in civil engineering.
